headline: Lego Donkey Kong Arcade playable cabinet set launches August 1 for $200
summary: This 1,371-piece Lego set features a working joystick, lever, and barrel-launching mechanism, recreating the classic arcade experience.
details: Lego is releasing a new 1,371-piece Donkey Kong Arcade set, continuing its collaboration with Nintendo. This playable replica pays tribute to the iconic arcade game that started it all.
The set is designed for nostalgic adult fans and includes a working lever to release barrels, a joystick to control Jumpman (the original Mario), and a button to make him jump over obstacles.

It meticulously recreates the first level of the Donkey Kong arcade game, complete with scaffold and ladders. The set also features Jumpman, Donkey Kong, and the damsel in distress, originally known as 'Lady' and later Pauline.
The back of the cabinet reveals a working barrel-shifting mechanism, showcasing intricate Lego engineering similar to the crank-operated Pac-Man set.
Priced at $200, the Lego Donkey Kong Arcade set is available for pre-order now and will officially launch on August 1.
caption:
Lego's latest Nintendo collaboration is a playable Donkey Kong arcade cabinet.
It launches August 1 for $200.

Lego is releasing a new 1,371-piece Donkey Kong Arcade set, continuing its collaboration with Nintendo. This playable replica pays tribute to the iconic arcade game that started it all.

The set is designed for nostalgic adult fans and includes a working lever to release barrels, a joystick to control Jumpman (the original Mario), and a button to make him jump over obstacles.

It meticulously recreates the first level of the Donkey Kong arcade game, complete with scaffold and ladders. The set also features Jumpman, Donkey Kong, and the damsel in distress, originally known as 'Lady' and later Pauline.

The back of the cabinet reveals a working barrel-shifting mechanism, showcasing intricate Lego engineering similar to the crank-operated Pac-Man set.

Priced at $200, the Lego Donkey Kong Arcade set is available for pre-order now and will officially launch on August 1.

Source: Engadget, Tom's Hardware
